description.value:
Begin Siege

Establish a multi-turn siege on a target hex. Layers are drawn from the hex's structureActorIds (or GM override at planning time). Commits a Supply Buffer in marks that ticks down per turn from the derived Siege Cost (terrain + supply-chain length + harassment, less Bulwark discount). Resolves over multiple campaign turns until a layer is breached, defender surrenders, attacker withdraws, or Buffer is exhausted. See bbttcc-raid/SIEGE_RAID_TYPE_SPEC.md.

Cost: Violence 23 · Logistics 15 · Economy 8 marks
